analysis.title: Mueller Water Products Inc. (MWA): Solid F4Q26 margin execution; portfolio optimization supports further F2027 margin expansion; Neutral
key_insights: MWA reported F4Q26 revenue of $376.5mn, down 1.1% yoy and in line with GSe/FactSet consensus of ~$376mn, as lower volumes were partly offset by higher pricing.

F4Q26 adjusted operating margin was 21.9%, up 120bps yoy and above GSe of 20.2%, helped by pricing, lower SG&A and better manufacturing performance, partly offset by inflation, lower volumes, unfavorable mix and tariffs.
Water Flow Solutions adjusted operating margin was 28.2% vs GSe 27.3%. Water Management Solutions adjusted operating margin was 21.7% vs GSe 21.1%.
F2027 adjusted EBITDA guidance is $378mn-$388mn. The midpoint implies a 26.3% margin, +110bps yoy and above GSe of 25.2%, or about +150bps excluding a ~40bps tariff refund benefit in F2026.

Of the ~150bps normalized margin expansion, roughly 100bps comes from portfolio optimization and ~40-50bps from manufacturing performance and SG&A productivity, despite unfavorable mix. The metering transition adds ~120bps of annualized margin benefit ramping through F2027, and the i2O exit adds a further benefit.
F2027 net sales guidance is $1.44bn-$1.47bn, excluding ~$40mn of FY26 metering revenue, vs GSe/FactSet consensus of $1.49bn/$1.50bn. Excluding metering, guidance implies ~1.5% sales growth.

Management expects residential construction down low single digits after a double-digit decline in FY26, and municipal customers to stay cautious on inflation-pressured budgets. GS expects municipal repair and replacement demand to stay relatively resilient.
Specialty valves are expected to grow double digits in F2027 on industrial water applications. Data-center-related demand is growing at a high rate off a small base.
Management expects 2H27 net sales and adjusted EBITDA margin to be higher than 1H27.
GS raised F2027/F2028E EPS by 6%/10% to $1.58/$1.69 on a better margin profile, and introduced F2029E EPS of $1.75. F2027E revenue was cut 3% to $1,456.3mn.
GS raised its 12-month price target to $27 from $24, based on 16x P/E (unchanged) on Q5-Q8 EPS. Rating stays Neutral with 12.3% upside from $24.04.
Residential recovery pace is the key variable for incremental operating leverage given MWA's vertically integrated manufacturing footprint.

market_movers.rationale: GS raised the target to $27 from $24 on higher margin-driven EPS estimates, using an unchanged 16x P/E on Q5-Q8 EPS. Rating remains Neutral.

earnings_insights: F4Q26 (reported 11/5/2026) revenue $376.5mn vs GSe $376.3mn and FactSet consensus ~$376mn, down 1.1% yoy per the text.
F4Q26 non-GAAP diluted EPS $0.38 vs GSe $0.38, flat vs estimate. GAAP diluted EPS $0.33 vs GSe $0.38.
F4Q26 adjusted EBITDA $95.5mn vs GSe $92.8mn (+3%), adjusted EBITDA margin 25.4% vs GSe 24.7%.
F4Q26 free cash flow to equity $96.7mn vs GSe $90.4mn. Capex was $12.0mn vs GSe $19.0mn.
F2027 guidance (company): net sales $1.44bn-$1.47bn vs GSe/FactSet consensus $1.49bn/$1.50bn. Adjusted EBITDA $378mn-$388mn vs prior GSe $376.4mn.
GS estimates (forecasts): F2027E revenue $1,456.3mn (prior $1,495.0mn), adjusted EBITDA $382.9mn (prior $376.4mn), non-GAAP EPS $1.58 (prior $1.49). F2028E EPS $1.69 (prior $1.53). F2029E EPS $1.75.
risk_factors: Ability to pass through raw material cost increases.
Continued residential weakness and cautious municipal spending.
Tariffs and inflation weighed on F4Q26 margins.
